test_freq_getter_no_warning: test that getting idx.freq on a PeriodIndex produces no warning
test_freq_setter_raises_attribute_error: test that setting idx.freq on a PeriodIndex raises AttributeError with no setter message
create_period_range: create a PeriodIndex using period_range with a start period and number of periods
test_assert_produces_warning_none: test that a code block produces no warnings using tm.assert_produces_warning(None)
test_raises_attribute_error_with_match: test that a code block raises AttributeError matching a specific message using pytest.raises
